ios.desc:
You screenshot things for a reason.

That recipe. That concert. That book recommendation. That product you wanted.

Now they're buried in your camera roll, lost between memes and accidental lock screen captures.

Unbury finds them.

HOW IT WORKS

On-device AI (no cloud, no wifi needed) understands why you saved each screenshot. Every screenshot gets sorted automatically:

Watch - Movies, shows, videos
Buy - Products, wishlists
Read - Articles, books, recipes
Listen - Music, podcasts
Event - Concerts, plans, dates
Place - Restaurants, travel spots
Inspo - Aesthetic saves, ideas
Memory - Personal moments

No manual tagging. No folders. Just open and find.

DAILY DIGEST

Each day, Unbury surfaces what matters now. That concert is Saturday. That recipe is perfect for tonight. Your past self, reminding your present self.

SMART REMINDERS

Friday evening? Here's what to watch this weekend.
Event coming up? Don't miss the concert you saved months ago.
Weekly recaps of everything you saved.

INSIGHTS

Daily cards that reflect patterns in what you save. Playful roasts. Genuine hype. Predictions. All surprisingly personal.

PRIVACY FIRST

Everything stays on your device. No cloud. No uploads. No account needed. The AI downloads once, then works completely offline.

FREE VS PRO

Free: 10 screenshots/day, 5-day history, 1 daily insight
Pro: Unlimited processing, full history, all insights, background processing

Your screenshots are a map of your interests, intentions, and the life you're building.

Stop scrolling past them. Start using them.

Unbury - Remember what you saved.

quotes.text:
I built Unbury because as someone with ADHD, I kept screenshotting things I swore I'd come back to - and ofc never did. That restaurant someone recommended. A book I saw on someone's story. Concert tickets I meant to buy. All buried under 100,000 screenshots I'll never scroll through.

So I built an AI that actually understands why you saved each screenshot and sorts them automatically - Watch, Buy, Read, Listen, Event, Place, Inspo, Memory. The part I'm most proud of: everything runs 100% on your device (edge AI). No cloud. No account. No wifi needed. The AI downloads once during setup, then works completely offline.

Would love to hear how you use your screenshots - or if you're like me, how you forget about them.
